description: ACTION on the WordPress site. Creates a blog post. content is HTML (WordPress blocks optional). Default status is draft (not visible to readers); use publish only if the user explicitly asks, or future with date (ISO 8601) to schedule. In safe mode the first call returns a PREVIEW with confirm_id: show it and call again with confirm_id only after the user approves. Not retried on network errors (no duplicates): if it times out, check with wp_list_posts before retrying.

confirm_id.description: Token di conferma ritornato dall'anteprima. Ripassa lo STESSO payload + confirm_id per eseguire davvero la scrittura.
